climbFlightLease20261023.finding: Automatic climb directly issued flyInHeight outside the shared aircraft mutation lease. A retained local climb flag prevented later completed-insertion reuse. Shutdown cleared aircraft drop hold without checking its insertion episode.
implementation: One-shot AIRBORNE_CLIMB acquisition at priority50, below existing braking100/attack300/defence400/landing500. Validate current exact lease before flyInHeight, mark requested only inside that boundary, then immediately release. Refused acquisition leaves flag unset.

Exact current-owner insertion finish clears its own climb flag with aircraft hold. Shutdown checks nonempty exact job episode and actual aircraft locality before clearing hold/flag/episode; stale jobs cannot erase successor aircraft state.
No additional flight worker, persistent lease or guessed original altitude. Existing documented post-drop height remains until mission/controller supplies a later instruction.

validation.provenance: Unsigned dirty development snapshot including preserved unrelated dirt; engineering notes afterward.

limits: Lease release proves only request-boundary retirement, not native altitude acknowledgement or restoration.
A climb request before an insertion that never starts still retains its one-shot flag; no unowned automatic height reset or new retry loop introduced.
Actual controller preemption, repeated drops, abort/locality timing and runtime overhead remain unverified. Audits paused; no launch or publishing.

Empty rider selection, exact current insertion finish and existing local shutdown remove metadata without height commands.

landingRosterScope20261024.finding: DROP captures cargo/FFV passengers and excludes operating crew, but LAND used every alive current group member. A same-group pilot remaining aboard prevented actual landed cargo from completing tracking. Whole-group fallback SAD also needs a stronger participant boundary because it retasks all members.
landingRosterScope20261024.change: LAND alive roster is original jumpers still alive in original group. An original airborne/aboard member remains pending until original deadline; departed actors are not recalled. Fallback SAD additionally requires every alive current group member to be in that landed cargo, retaining existing no-authored-waypoint and external-control gates. Mixed crew/cargo and later nonparticipant joins get no fallback. No eject, inventory, flight, sensing, deadline, worker or scheduler change.
landingRosterScope20261024.sourceIntent: Original Protocol selects cargo separately from gunners/pilot; CBE retains that roster distinction through landing and rejects whole-group ground orders over unrelated crew. No source copying or full parity claim.
landingRosterScope20261024.remainingRequiredScope: Independent landed-passenger ground-task handover inside a mixed aircrew/cargo group remains unimplemented; withholding a whole-group SAD is not that implementation. Actual insertion, landing/equipment, repeated reuse, HC/replication and overhead remain unverified.
